checks.criterion: C6: effective capability description matches enabled media
checks.detail: The description says "No ... media grants" while allow-android-account-commands grants register_media/release_media and runtime_capabilities advertises media=provided. This misdescribes the effective capability. No unauthorized command or runtime failure was demonstrated.

findings.trigger: Read the main-android capability description after Android account-bound media was enabled.
findings.effect: The description says "No ... media grants" while allow-android-account-commands grants register_media/release_media and runtime_capabilities advertises media=provided. This misdescribes the effective capability. No unauthorized command or runtime failure was demonstrated.
findings.suggestedNextAction: Update the description to include native account-bound media and retain the desktop-browser/external-execution exclusions. No product change was made during this audit.
